industries.narrative: Managed care ripping with 82% advancing and +4.3% cap-weighted move led by UNH; volume soft suggests short-covering or relief rally rather than fresh institutional accumulation.

sector_breadth_notes.note: XLV strength is narrow — driven almost entirely by Healthcare Plans (managed care). No other healthcare sub-industry cleared the 6.5 gate.
XLF qualifying at sector level but internals are weak: Capital Markets, Credit Services, and Shell Companies all scoring below 3.0. Sector strength likely from banks not shown here.
XLY deeply bifurcated — Autos, Lodging, RVs, Furnishings all at deep laggards (score <3, breadth <25%). Sector lift must be coming from a narrow winner set.
XLRE weak internally: Residential and Office REITs both scoring under 2.7 with breadth under 22%. Sector-level qualification looks fragile.

key_divergences: Sharp divergence: XLV qualifies only via Healthcare Plans while consumer-cyclical (Autos, Lodging, Furnishings) and rate-sensitive REITs (Residential, Office) are collapsing. Suggests defensive rotation, not risk-on breadth.
leadership_theme: Managed care leading defensively; consumer cyclicals and rate-sensitive REITs broadly rolling over.
